[SWS_CM_11047] DDS serialization of CppImplementationDataType of cat- egory VECTOR
⌈
A CppImplementationDataType of category VECTOR shall be
serialized according to the standard serialization rules for DDS SEQUENCE_TYPE de-
fined in section 7.4.3.5 of [20]. Binding implementations shall serialize VECTOR CppImplementationDataTypes
with more than one dimension, as nested DDS sequences.
⌋
